rationale: v1.80.1 already has opening info, warm View drafts, room Area navigation, device: bindings (devices.ts:1204) and baseZoom kiosk version recovery (version-recovery-card.ts:196). This repairs and polishes these existing user paths. Device-bound Group presentation is a stable group/binding polish, not a repair restricted to the newer #878 entity-icon implementation.

summary.ru: Актуальные понятные карточки дверей, восстановление настроек и увеличенного киоска, доступные переходы в HA и узнаваемые группы света.
summary.en: Current readable door cards, restored device settings and enlarged kiosk views, accessible HA links and recognizable light groups.
